thread:
leah_sales: Quick sync for HarborTrust POC. Req: SAML SSO (Okta + Azure AD), SCIM for provisioning (delta + one-time bulk), group->role mapping (they use nested groups heavily), delegated admin for HR approvers, and domain verification across 4 bank subdomains. Procurement asks for a short buyer blurb, security line, and a predictable monthly pricing model. Also asked whether passwords or national IDs ever persist.

matt_backend: SCIM notes: we support SCIM 2.0, delta sync, and a one-time bulk seed. We also offer an SFTP-based bulk import for customers who prefer non-API ingestion. Hosted default is 100 req/s per-tenant with token smoothing; Dedicated provides reserved workers and "throughput credits" for ramps. SCIM is idempotent when externalId or userName is used as the unique key.

reza_se: For nested groups we flatten membership into a single list by default so RBAC decisions are deterministic. If they need hierarchy preserved we can include ancestry metadata (includeNested=true) but that increases payloads. Ask them to provide a sample Okta group export to validate size and cycles.

aline_sec: Security blurb for procurement: "Redwood never stores plaintext passwords or national identifiers. Provisioning attributes (email, externalId, groups, optional fields) are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and in transit (TLS1.2+). For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed KMS/HSM and provide audit logs for all provisioning events. Optional PII fields can be redacted on request."

beth_pricing: Pricing model (summary): base provisioning tier covers up to N active users; above that we charge per-active-user in bands. Ramps can be covered with a time-limited throughput add-on or by moving to Dedicated which adds a reserved-capacity fee. For predictability we can provide a flat monthly provisioning bundle for the ramp period (e.g., 3 weeks) and revert to banded billing after. I'll pull exact bands from pricing and return a ballpark.

leah_sales: Any operational blockers we should surface to the buyer now?

matt_backend: Request: sample SCIM export, list of custom Okta transforms, whether they need SCIM webhooks (we support them but require public endpoint/IP whitelist or proxy), and confirmation if they want SFTP bulk import. Note: webhooks may be subject to backpressure; we recommend using our audit API or a durable queue if they need guaranteed delivery.

aline_sec: Flag: if they mandate on-prem HSM with air-gapped key exchange or require data residency in a private network zone, that moves to Private deployment and needs infra lead time. Otherwise nothing blocking.

reza_se: Tech snippet for procurement (paste):

"provisioning:
  protocol: SCIM 2.0
  bulk_import: API | SFTP
  delta_sync: true
  unique_key: externalId | userName
  group_mapping: idp.group -> app.role (flattened by default; ancestry optional)
  hosted_default_rate: 100req/s (token smoothing)
  dedicated: reserved workers + throughput credits (SLA option)
security:
  transport: TLS1.2+
  at_rest: AES-256-GCM
  kms: customer-managed optional
  pii_handling: no plaintext passwords or national IDs; redact optional fields
"

leah_sales: Great — I will send buyer blurb + security line and request the sample export and ramp dates. Beth, ping pricing for a 3-week ramp bundle estimate. Aline, can you start the vendor questionnaire?

aline_sec: On it. Will flag anything high risk. Expect first pass in 48h. :thumbsup:
